note: Proposes an open Polymath-style collaboration to turn the Lean certificate announced by Levent Alpöge into a human-readable proof of the Riemann and generalised Riemann hypotheses. It aims to pool efforts worldwide, avoid duplication and explore the new mathematics inside the computer proof.
title: G.R.H. Polymath
who: Anurag Sahay (Duke University), Will Sawin and Lior Silberman (University of British Columbia), guest post on Terence Tao's blog
